name: MonarchListRow
title: List row
summary: A row of a list: an optional leading icon or avatar, one to three lines of text and an optional trailing element.
whenToUse: For settings, records and navigation lists: invoices, members, files, a menu of screens.
whenNotToUse: For data with columns to compare use the data table. For a choice among options use radio rows or checkbox rows, which carry the selection semantics.
api: @Composable fun MonarchListRow(headlineContent: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, overlineContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, supportingContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, leadingContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, trailingContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, selected: Boolean = false, divider: Boolean = false, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the row; a test tag or semantics reach the row's one TalkBack element.

options.name: overlineContent
options.description: A small muted line above the headline.

options.name: supportingContent
options.description: A muted line under the headline.

options.name: leadingContent
options.description: An icon, avatar or checkbox before the text, in a 24dp box.

options.name: trailingContent
options.description: An element after the text: a badge, a value, a chevron or a button.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Makes the whole row one tap target with the button role; null for plain content.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the row can be tapped; a disabled row uses the disabled text colour.

options.name: selected
options.description: The current choice: the accent subtle fill, announced as selected.

options.name: divider
options.description: A subtle 1dp line under the row.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: To observe or drive press, hover and focus.

states.name: resting
states.description: No fill; the headline in the default text colour, the other lines muted.

states.name: hovered and pressed
states.description: One surface step (the muted fill) on a tappable row.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring around the row for keyboard and D-pad focus.

states.name: selected
states.description: The accent subtle fill; announced as selected.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every line in the disabled text colour; announced as disabled and ignores taps.

appearance: At least 48dp high with 16dp at the sides and 12dp between the leading element, the text and the trailing element. No shadow and no card around it; rows in a list are separated by the subtle divider, in every theme including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: It replaces the Material 3 ListItem and keeps its slot names, so a call changes by its name only; the colors, tonalElevation and shadowElevation arguments go. The web has no list row component; its lists use the same anatomy (16 at the sides, 14 medium headline, 14 muted supporting line).
accessibility: A tappable row is one TalkBack element with the button role; its lines are read together.
The touch target is at least 48dp high.
A selected row is announced as selected; a disabled row as disabled.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0; the row grows instead of cutting it.
edgeCases: Put the row's own controls (a switch, a menu button) in trailingContent and leave onClick null, so there are not two tap targets for one action.
Text in the slots takes the row's styles; pass a style only to override them.

examples.title: Invoices
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchListRow(
        headlineContent = { Text("Invoice INV-1042") },
        supportingContent = { Text("Acme Corp · Paid Mar 3") },
        leadingContent = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
        trailingContent = { Text("$420.00") },
        onClick = {},
        divider = true,
    )
    MonarchListRow(
        headlineContent = { Text("Invoice INV-1043") },
        supportingContent = { Text("Globex · Due Mar 18") },
        leadingContent = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
        trailingContent = { MonarchBadge(text = "Due", tone = MonarchTone.Warning) },
        onClick = {},
    )
}
